class.name: NetwEffectLedger
class.brief_description: Keyed ledger of optimistic acts, each a revert parked against a deadline tick.
class.description: [method adopt] keeps the act and drops its revert. [method discard] and a timeout run it, so a timeout is a denial rather than a third outcome. The ledger never reads a clock. A deadline is measured against the tick [method sweep] is handed, which is what keeps the span testable and what makes the session, not the ledger, the owner of the default timeout. A watcher is refused unless its key is armed, so an observer can never outlive the act it observes. [NetwMultiplayer] owns the session's ledger and publishes it as the [code]effect_*[/code] verbs. Reach for those rather than for this class.

method.name: adopt
method.description: Resolves [param key] as kept. The pending revert is dropped unrun and a watcher's confirmed callback fires.

method.name: arm
method.description: Registers [param key] with [param revert] until it is resolved or [param deadline_tick] passes. Re-arming an armed key replaces it silently. An empty [param key] arms nothing.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets every armed act and every watcher. No revert runs.

method.name: count
method.description: Returns how many acts are armed and unresolved.

method.name: discard
method.description: Resolves [param key] as reverted. The pending revert runs immediately and a watcher's denied callback fires after it.

method.name: pending
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while [param key] is armed and unresolved.

method.name: sweep
method.description: Discards every act whose deadline is at or before [param tick]. The expired set is collected before the first revert runs, so an act armed by a revert during the sweep is kept rather than swept. The expired set is collected before the first revert runs, so an act a revert arms mid-sweep is kept rather than swept by the same pass that woke the one that armed it.

method.name: watch
method.description: Observes [param key]'s resolution and returns [code]true[/code]. Returns [code]false[/code] without registering when [param key] is not armed.
